content.title: Hazard Gauntlet | False Safety Escalates into a Scale Threat
content.summary: Let the same subject continuously pass through multiple local dangers in a single escape direction, and each recovery is only temporary safety; after arriving at a seemingly faster or safer vehicle at a later stage, a larger-scale environmental threat will be used to redefine the entire route.

quick_start.input_format: Same escape direction + at least two local dangers + visible recovery + temporary safety vehicle + larger-scale terminal threat
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original watch archives, a brass courier beetle runs along the walnut index conveyor belt towards the blue collection lamp, and a drawer collapses behind it; the seam of the conveyor belt is broken, and the beetle crosses over and falls to the next section by hanging the catalog ribbon, the blue light is still in front; a room-scale paper cyclone is activated at the end of the table, filling the target aisle; the beetle, tram and cyclone are in the same frame, and there is no claim of escape at the end
required_anchors: Establish one subject and one persistent escape direction before the hazard chain.
Use at least two materially different local hazards with visible recoveries between them.
Provide one brief apparent safety upgrade or open platform late in the sequence.
Use one terminal scale reveal to reclassify the apparent safety state without inventing survival beyond the visible ending.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let the same subject continuously pass through multiple local dangers in a single escape direction, and each recovery is only temporary safety; after arriving at a seemingly faster or safer vehicle at a later stage, a larger-scale environmental threat will be used to redefine the entire route.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Chain several visually distinct local hazards along one continuous escape direction, let the subject repeatedly recover, grant one brief apparent safety upgrade, then reveal a single environmental-scale threat that dwarfs both subject and escape platform.

invariants.rule: Establish one subject and one persistent escape direction before the hazard chain.
invariants.purpose: Binds separate dangers into one route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated directions make the sequence feel like a montage.

invariants.rule: Use at least two materially different local hazards with visible recoveries between them.
invariants.purpose: Builds escalation through changing physical duties.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated copies of one obstacle create no meaningful progression.

invariants.rule: Keep the same subject and route logic traceable through every recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Subject or geography resets break the causal chain.

invariants.rule: Provide one brief apparent safety upgrade or open platform late in the sequence.
invariants.purpose: Creates a readable baseline for the final reversal of scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without temporary relief, the ending is merely another hazard.

invariants.rule: Use one terminal scale reveal to reclassify the apparent safety state without inventing survival beyond the visible ending.
invariants.purpose: Makes the final threat change the meaning of all prior escapes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Claiming an unseen outcome overstates the evidence and weakens the hold.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
